comment: Temporary exceptions for root-workspace npm audit findings that have no released fix and are not exploitable in our build/dev tooling. Each entry must include a removal trigger.

exceptions.title: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
exceptions.removalTrigger: Upgrade Vite / typescript-eslint / vitest to releases that no longer depend on a vulnerable picomatch range, or wait for a patched picomatch release and refresh package-lock.json.
exceptions.reason: picomatch is used only by build-time and lint-time tooling (Vite, ESLint, vitest) with repository-controlled glob patterns. There is no user-supplied glob input and no runtime attack surface.
